An earlier form of this word, woodshock, still sometimes designates the marten. Also a doublet of wejack.

thesaurus.definition: reddish brown North American marmot

wiktionary.gloss: A rodent of the family Sciuridae, belonging to the group of large ground squirrels known as marmots, Marmota monax.
Having the joy and vitality associated with younger people, despite one's own advanced age.
